reviews.finding: The C0 bridge binds parent and candidate payload hashes, recomputes the exact edge residual, and rejects unrelated true identities before opening selection.
Scope/carrier authority, pending raw structural status, external-attestation blocking, and human-selection boundaries are scientifically disciplined.
Profile isolation, action validation, error taxonomy, C0 recheck binding, and hash-bound chain selection are covered by targeted regression tests.

known_limits: External verifier JSON is an attestation pending a registered recheck; it is not trusted proof.
The bundled trusted recheck path currently covers C0 SymPy identity claims only.
Human decision artifacts have SHA integrity and declared role provenance, not cryptographic identity authentication.
release_scope: Commit the architecture contracts, schemas, C0/raw migrations, target documentation/workflow maps, routing record, validation packet, and focused tests. Exclude scripts/run_c0_chain_demo.py.
